www-6548628.name: Wipeout
www-6548628.author: Old Legend
www-6548628.description: The fun and popular KoGaMa series is back with another challenge for you to take. In Kogama Wipeout, a cool multiplayer online run and jump platform game, you have to control your lovely little character though a path full of gaps and obstacles that make this game really hard but also very amusing. Avoid falling down to the water or you may have to start over again. Reach checkpoint flags and collect coins to purchase useful gadgets that you help you get further and reach the end of the impossible race. Enjoy Kogama Wipeout!
